MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of marine and freshwater environments? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish feeds and feeding? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish feeds and feeding.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish feeds and feeding.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish feeds and feeding.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish feeds and feeding.

9. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Decomposers only

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.

11. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Reproduction? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Reproduction.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Reproduction.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Reproduction.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Reproduction.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.

14. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Ecology and Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and climatic conditions in marine and Freshwater and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Fishery by-products and their industrial uses 4.0 Marine Operations and Blue Eco and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Fishery by- products and their industrial uses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Safety of Humans and Equipment in Marine Activities 4.2 Marine Operations and Se and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Maritime Operations and Seamanship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
